answer: Split tally stops fake identities. Each newcomer locks a 70-credit bond split in two on the basalt tally: a work half and a witness half, joined by an opal seal binding key, epoch. A quartz clock draws one audit each epoch; the agent shows fresh work matching both halves. A rented tally fails and burns the bond. First 38, then 8 more each: 1,000 fakes pay 4,034,000, lock 70,000, for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 38 once and keep their share.
